apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: vuoro-control-migrate
  namespace: vuoro-system
  annotations:
    kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/force: enabled
spec:
  backoffLimit: 6
  ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 86400
  template:
    metadata: {labels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: vuoro-control-migrate}}
    spec:
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      imagePullSecrets: [{name: vuoro-ghcr-pull}]
      securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 65532, runAsGroup: 65532, fsGroup: 65532, seccompProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}}
      containers:
        - name: migrate
          image: ghcr.io/bayleafwalker/vuoro-cloud@sha256:02b792fdf2324ad56ea3ae7a85e82c348b88ae00894bc2991c678f5b065875bf
          command: [python, /app/migrate.py]
          env:
            - {name: VUORO_CLOUD_SERVICE_ROLE, value: control}
            # DB role split (unit 1.5, G3): migrations run as
            # vuoro_control_owner, which owns every object from
            # migrations/021 on; never as vuoro_control again. Only the
            # database URL is needed (scripts/migrate.py).
            - {name: VUORO_CLOUD_DATABASE_URL, valueFrom: {secretKeyRef: {name: vuoro-control-migrate-db, key: VUORO_CLOUD_DATABASE_URL}}}
          resources: {requests: {cpu: 25m, memory: 64Mi}, limits: {cpu: 250m, memory: 256Mi}}
          securityContext: {allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: [ALL]}}
